variety: British English spelling (Oxford/Cambridge learner-dictionary conventions), variety-neutral vocabulary where possible. See design/english-variety.md.
note: All example sentences are constructed for teaching purposes.

chunks.meaning: Please say it again.
chunks.example: Sorry, could you repeat that? I didn't catch the time.

chunks.meaning: Please speak less fast.
chunks.example: Could you say that more slowly, please?

chunks.meaning: Please say the letters one by one.
chunks.example: Could you spell the street name, please?

chunks.meaning: I repeat what I understood and ask if it is correct.
chunks.example: So, platform four at ten fifteen, is that right?

chunks.meaning: I don't know this word. Please explain it.
chunks.example: Sorry, what does 'off-peak' mean?

chunks.text: Excuse me, can you help me?
chunks.meaning: A polite way to start talking to a stranger or staff.
chunks.example: Excuse me, can you help me? I'm looking for the ticket office.

chunks.text: My card doesn't work in the machine.
chunks.meaning: The machine does not accept my card.
chunks.example: My card doesn't work in the machine. Can I buy a ticket here?

chunks.meaning: A ticket to go there and come back.
chunks.example: A return to Seaview, please.

chunks.meaning: I will return later today.
chunks.example: A return, please. I'm coming back this evening.

chunks.meaning: Is it OK to pay with a bank card?
chunks.example: Can I pay by card, or is it cash only?

chunks.text: Which platform does it leave from?
chunks.meaning: Where does the train start from in the station?
chunks.example: Which platform does the Seaview train leave from?

chunks.text: Go straight on, then turn left.
chunks.meaning: Walk forward, then go to the left.
chunks.example: Go straight on, past the café, then turn left.

chunks.meaning: How many minutes or hours is the journey?
chunks.example: How long does it take to get to Seaview?

chunks.text: Thanks very much for your help.
chunks.meaning: A friendly way to say thank you and finish.
chunks.example: That's great. Thanks very much for your help.

chunks.meaning: A polite way to ask for food or a drink.
chunks.example: Could I have a tomato soup, please?

chunks.meaning: Now I order for the other person.
chunks.example: And for my friend, the vegetable curry.

chunks.meaning: Nuts make her ill, so she can't eat them.
chunks.example: She's allergic to nuts, so she can't have the cake.

chunks.text: Does it have any nuts in it?
chunks.meaning: Are there nuts in this food?
chunks.example: Does the salad have any nuts in it?

chunks.meaning: What food is inside this dish?
chunks.example: What's in the Harbour salad?

chunks.meaning: I choose a different thing.
chunks.example: No problem. I'll have the soup instead.

chunks.meaning: We will eat here, at a table.
chunks.example: To eat in, please. We're sitting by the window.

chunks.meaning: I don't want anything else.
chunks.example: Two waters as well. That's all, thanks.

chunks.meaning: My throat hurts.
chunks.example: I've got a sore throat and a bit of a cough.

chunks.meaning: Since + a starting point; for + a length of time.
chunks.example: I've had it since Monday. I've had it for two days.

chunks.meaning: What do you think I should buy for this?
chunks.example: Can you recommend something for a sore throat?

chunks.text: I'm not taking any other medicine.
chunks.meaning: I don't use any other medicine now.
chunks.example: No, I'm not taking any other medicine at the moment.

chunks.text: How often should I take it?
chunks.meaning: How many times, and when?
chunks.example: How often should I take it? Before or after meals?

chunks.meaning: Do I need to visit a doctor?
chunks.example: What if it doesn't get better? Should I see a doctor?

chunks.text: I have a booking under the name ...
chunks.meaning: I reserved a room, and this is the name on it.
chunks.example: Hi, I have a booking under the name Rossi.

chunks.text: I booked it online last week.
chunks.meaning: I reserved it on the internet seven days ago.
chunks.example: I booked it online last week, for three nights.

chunks.meaning: This message shows my booking.
chunks.example: Here's my confirmation email. It has a booking number.

chunks.meaning: Do you have a different free room?
chunks.example: Is there another room available tonight?

chunks.meaning: A polite way to ask for something that is not normal.
chunks.example: Would it be possible to stay in the dormitory tonight?

chunks.text: I don't mind sharing a room.
chunks.meaning: It's OK for me to sleep in a room with other people.
chunks.example: I don't mind sharing a room for one night.

chunks.meaning: That is OK. I agree.
chunks.example: The private room from tomorrow? That works for me.
